summary: Celcuity Inc. filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a $500 million offering of 0.250% convertible senior notes due 2032. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, convertible under specified conditions at an initial conversion price of ~$124.53 per share. The offering is a routine capital markets transaction and does not involve a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing merely raises debt capital via convertible notes with standard conversion and redemption features. No special-situations event is present.
